high performance computational modeling of heterogeneous SOCF electrode microstructures is possible, and can be used to understand and improve performance at considerable length scales.

ERMINE can be used to simulate electrochemical activity at considerable length scales and high resolution, and that this activity can be used to predict the macroscopic behavior of electrochemical energy devices.
